raw_annotations.proposed_function: Formation of continuously growing clusters and micelles via hydrophobic and electrostatic interactions (protein-protein contacts).
raw_annotations.evidence: Under these conditions, unphosphorylated TDP-43-LCD (non-phLCD) readily formed continuously growing clusters (Figure 2b), consistent with its strong experimental propensity for phase separation.[3, 43]
raw_annotations.curator_note: Qualitative mention of the LCD region; specific residue coordinates for the full LCD are not explicitly defined in this snippet, though block boundaries (1-49, 50-99, 101-148) are mentioned later. Suggest UniProt lookup for canonical TDP-43 LCD boundaries.

raw_annotations.proposed_function: Assembly into small, roughly spherical clusters (micelles) with a dense core and diffuse corona.
raw_annotations.evidence: In contrast, both 12pS and 12DD variants assembled into multiple small, roughly spherical clusters containing ~20-40 chains that remained stable over extended simulation times, which is indicative of micellization.
